command:
cd /code && Rscript -e 'library(readr); library(dplyr); d1<-read_csv("/data/summary_stats_LSS1.csv", na="NaN"); d1<-filter(d1, id != 35); cat(sprintf("LSS1 speed medians walk=%.6f search=%.6f
", median(d1$walk_path_speed, na.rm=TRUE), median(d1$search_path_speed, na.rm=TRUE))); cat(sprintf("LSS1 straightness medians walk=%.6f search=%.6f
", median(d1$walk_straightness, na.rm=TRUE), median(d1$search_straightness, na.rm=TRUE))); d2<-read_csv("/data/summary_stats_LSS2.csv", na = "NaN"); d2<-filter(d2, id != 212 & id != 203); cat(sprintf("LSS2 speed medians walk=%.6f search=%.6f
", median(d2$walk_path_speed, na.rm=TRUE), median(d2$search_path_speed, na.rm=TRUE))); cat(sprintf("LSS2 straightness medians walk=%.6f search=%.6f
", median(d2$walk_straightness, na.rm=TRUE), median(d2$search_straightness, na.rm=TRUE)));' > /results/medians.txt 2>&1; sed -n '1,120p' /results/medians.txt
